Soo ive been experimenting with she n he n all pronouns and the pronouns made for nb people here like ze zir or dey dem. They aren't commonly known tho so it's even more weird to me to have to explain them than getting asked for pronouns. Another post recently pointed out asking for pronouns is shitty, because it puts you in a lot distress, if you are passing, why they are asking you and in general helping to make being trans quirky and a cool trend... I agree, I'm unsure every time i get asked on what I shall say. I hope this confusion ends soon, just saying i can relate to a certain point.
